name: The refresh token was spent outside the browser: the application drops it and gets a new one by the cookie, unnoticed
description: The test takes the refresh token the application keeps in the browser and spends it once itself, without touching the application at all. The renewal of the application is then a second use of the same token, and the provider refuses it. What follows is the whole point: the doubtful token is dropped instead of being presented again, and the renewal goes on through the hidden iframe, which asks with the SSO session cookie. The user sees nothing, and a fresh refresh token appears in the storage. This is the behaviour where the provider shares the site with the application; where the browser keeps its cookie out of the iframe there is nothing left to renew with, and the popup comes instead.
